verdict.rationale: No dedicated sandbox environment is documented. The only workaround is indirect: the API can create a separate organization and copy settings into it, and every request is scoped by organization_id, so testing in a throwaway org could isolate production data. The free plan could host such an org, but none of this is presented as a sandbox. Missing for 10: a documented sandbox or test environment, a separate sandbox API endpoint or test credentials, data-seeding or reset tooling, a sandbox mode for MCP or agent access, and any hands-on corroboration.
